D.name: re-observe
D.description: Re-sample, calibrate, denoise, aggregate, or change measurement granularity.

I.name: differentiate
I.description: Extract distinctions, regularities, contrasts, and context-dependent relations from observations.

K.name: abduce-model
K.description: Generate causal or generative hypotheses directly from observations while exposing assumptions.

W.name: salience-evaluate
W.description: Assess immediate welfare, risk, or value relevance of observations without assuming a final theory.

P.name: purpose-infer
P.description: Infer candidate purposes or demands from observed behavior, with a high risk of projection.

D.name: operationalize
D.description: Turn a relation or distinction into measurable variables, probes, and observations.

I.name: re-segment
I.description: Reframe, regroup, compress, or expand relational structure under another context.

K.name: generalize
K.description: Build explanatory, predictive, or causal models from relational patterns.

W.name: consequence-map
W.description: Translate patterns into value, risk, fairness, resilience, or long-term consequence structures.

P.name: question-form
P.description: Transform detected differences into questions, goals, or intervention candidates.

D.name: predict-test
D.description: Derive observable predictions and discriminating experiments from a model.

I.name: derive-signature
I.description: Extract relational signatures, implications, and compressed explanations from knowledge.

K.name: model-revise
K.description: Integrate, split, negate, analogize, or revise models while retaining provenance.

W.name: implication-audit
W.description: Evaluate model consequences, trade-offs, distributional effects, and unknown risks.

P.name: goal-design
P.description: Formulate controllable objectives, experiments, or commitments from a knowledge model.

D.name: value-directed-observe
D.description: Select observations required by safety, justice, welfare, or reversibility concerns.

I.name: value-reweight
I.description: Change which distinctions matter under different affected parties and horizons.

K.name: normative-model-select
K.description: Select, constrain, or challenge explanatory models using explicit values and harms.

W.name: value-negotiate
W.description: Expose conflicts among values, stakeholders, time horizons, and scales without forced consensus.

P.name: commit
P.description: Convert evaluated trade-offs into bounded purposes, duties, prohibitions, or exit conditions.

D.name: purpose-select-observation
D.description: Choose what to measure, sample, or preserve in order to pursue or audit a purpose.

I.name: purpose-frame
I.description: Choose distinctions and relations relevant to a purpose while logging excluded alternatives.

K.name: purpose-construct-knowledge
K.description: Select or construct models needed for a purpose, with explicit risk of motivated reasoning.

W.name: means-ends-audit
W.description: Audit whether a purpose and its means remain acceptable under consequences and other purposes.

P.name: purpose-transform
P.description: Split, merge, negotiate, suspend, reverse, or replace purposes and representation rights.
